### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Results directory of the run: one SAMPLE.zarr SpatialData store per sample (plus SAMPLE.explorer/ and pipeline_info/). |
| `IMAGE_ELEMENT` | — | Name of the morphology image element inside each store (images/NAME), set by the technology reader: image for the toy dataset, morphology_focus for Xenium, DATASETID_full_image for Visium HD. The viewer shows it and the cell coordinates are expressed in its pixels. |
| `GENES` | — | Optional comma-separated gene names (as in the cell table's var names) whose per-cell expression the Clusters and genes tab shows, e.g. the lineage markers of the tissue. Unset, the gene tiles are left out. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): sample name in METADATA_ID_COL, one column per factor. GROUP_COL becomes the condition column of the sample hub; the other factors are carried as extra columns. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table id column. Auto-detected as the first column. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design table factor the run compares, carried as the condition column. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`

**Origin** tells you whether a collection is *real pipeline data* or a reshape of it: <span class="gtd-badge gtd-direct">direct</span> = a pipeline output (scanned, or a recipe that reads raw files); <span class="gtd-badge gtd-derived">derived</span> = a recipe that reshapes one or more *direct* collections into the layout a visualization needs (no new measurement). **Reads** shows what produces it: a <span class="gtd-badge gtd-recipe">recipe</span> `.py` transform, or a raw <span class="gtd-badge gtd-file">file</span> scanned off disk. ### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/sopa/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sopa/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub of a sopa run: one row per sample, with its design and cell yield. | `sample`, `condition`, `n_cells`, `median_area`, `median_transcripts`, `n_clusters`, `method` |
| [`proseg/cell_metadata.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proseg/cell_metadata.py) | Proseg's per-cell metadata, as sopa stores it in the sample's cell table. | `sample`, `cell_id`, `cell_uid`, `area`, `volume`, `surface_area`, `surface_to_volume`, `scale`, `component`, `centroid_z` |
| [`sopa/cells.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/sopa/cells.py) | The cells of a sopa run, one row per cell, on a schema that does not move. | `sample`, `cell_id`, `cell_uid`, `x`, `y`, `area`, `method`, `cluster`, `cell_type`, `n_transcripts` |
| [`sopa/composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/sopa/composition.py) | What each sample is made of: its cells per cluster and per cell type. | `sample`, `annotation`, `label`, `n_cells`, `pct_cells`, `rank` |
| [`sopa/gene_expression.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/sopa/gene_expression.py) | Per-cell expression of a chosen gene list, long: one row per (cell, gene). | `sample`, `cell_id`, `cell_uid`, `cluster`, `cell_type`, `gene`, `expression` |
| [`sopa/gene_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/sopa/gene_summary.py) | Marker dot plot table: each chosen gene's mean expression and fraction of | `cluster`, `gene`, `mean_expression`, `frac_expressing`, `n_cells` |
